correctness.rationale: At \(b_1=1/a_1=:b\), the prey equation becomes \(u'=-a_1u(u-b)^2/(u+b_2)-uv\). For \(L=u+v+w/a_3\), exact cancellation gives \(L'=-a_1u(u-b)^2/(u+b_2)-a_2v-(a_4/a_3)w\), whose zero set is exactly \(E_0\) and \(E_b\). Positive invariance and compact Lyapunov sublevels give global precompact solutions; LaSalle plus monotonic \(u\) gives convergence to one of the two equilibria. On \(v=0\), the scalar equation gives the basin split and the reciprocal variable proves \(t(u-b)\to b+b_2\) for \(u(0)>b\).

value.rationale: The equality \(b_1=1/a_1\) is exactly the source condition for its global-extinction theorem and exactly the degeneracy where the Allee threshold and carrying equilibrium coalesce, so it is mathematically and ecologically motivated rather than an arbitrary parameter slice. The correction replaces a false global-attraction conclusion with a complete two-limit-state theorem and adds an exact invariant-plane basin split and sharp critical relaxation coefficient.
